title: Secure auth-flow module
objective: Measure whether the auth-flow craftbook scopes threats before writing a password/session flow with basic security controls.
prompt: In the `Auth Flow Eval` project, write `src/auth.js`: a small dependency-free ESM module for a session-based email/password login flow. Include registration, login, logout, session creation/validation, password hashing with Node crypto pbkdf2 or scrypt, CSRF token generation/validation, rate-limit bookkeeping, and safe error messages. Also write `notes/review.md` with a concise security review that covers password storage, session expiry, CSRF, rate limiting, and what is intentionally out of scope. Do not use live network services or real credentials.

setup.about: Self-contained eval project for auth-flow. Deliverables are workspace/src/auth.js and workspace/notes/review.md.
setup.missionObjectives: Build a small local auth module and a threat/security review covering storage, sessions, CSRF, and rate limiting.

success.summary: src/auth.js implements a local auth module and notes/review.md covers the required security controls.

axes.name: verification
axes.description: Self-tests exercise real behavior, not trivial truths.

axes.name: clarity
axes.description: Exports, naming, and structure make the module usable without reading every line.
